segments.ja218:1.1: Saṭhassa sāṭheyyamidaṃ sucintitaṃ, paccoḍḍitaṃ paṭikūṭassa kūṭaṃ;
segments.ja218:1.3: Phālañce khādeyyuṃ [adeyyuṃ (sī. pī.)] mūsikā, kasmā kumāraṃ kulalā na [no (sī. syā. pī.)] hareyyuṃ.
segments.ja218:2.1: Kūṭassa hi santi [santīdha (ka.)] kūṭakūṭā, bhavati [bhavanti (ka.)] cāpi nikatino nikatyā;
segments.ja218:2.3: Dehi puttanaṭṭha phālanaṭṭhassa phālaṃ, mā te puttamahāsi phālanaṭṭhoti.
